board: Adafruit AM2320 Digital Temperature and Humidity Sensor (product 3721, bare 4-lead sensor: VDD, SDA, GND, SCL)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The model uses the datasheet's I2C sequence (wake, 03 00 04, 8-byte reply, x10 values, CRC-16/Modbus checked against both example frames) and adds 4.7 kOhm pull-ups because the sensor has none. The sim temperature slider is limited to 0-80 C because the simulator cannot produce the chip's sign-magnitude negative temperatures; the driver still decodes them.
